title: Message from Wonder Woman
content: The gala starts at eight. Don't forget your invitation.

title: Message from Sherlock
content: The game is afoot. Meet me at 221B immediately.

title: Message from The Doctor
content: Quick question: do you prefer the 16th century or the 24th?

title: Message from Star-Lord
content: Have you seen my Zune? I think Rocket hid it again.

title: Message from Catwoman
content: That's a very shiny watch you're wearing today.

title: Message from Iron Man
content: Sent over those blueprints. Let me know if the math checks out.

title: Message from The Librarian
content: Your copy of 'The Necronomicon' is officially overdue.

title: Message from Spider-Man
content: Sorry I'm late! Got stuck in midtown traffic (literally).

title: Message from Batman
content: Your silence has been quite refreshing. Keep it up.

title: Message from Gandalf
content: Look to my coming at first light on the fifth day.

title: Message from The Oracle
content: Don't worry about the vase. You were going to break it anyway.

title: Message from ShadowByte
content: Your secrets are safer than you think... or are they?

title: Message from Neon Phantom
content: You left the lights on in your thoughts again.

title: Message from Frost Nova
content: Even the coldest minds can melt under pressure.

title: Message from Echo Rift
content: I heard what you said... even the part you didn’t.

title: Message from Crimson Specter
content: Not everything that follows you wants to be seen.

title: Message from Quantum Fox
content: Reality just glitched. Did you notice?

title: Message from Silent Pulse
content: Your heartbeat just told me everything.

title: Message from Astro Nomad
content: Somewhere in the universe, you already made the right choice.

title: Message from Pixel Warden
content: Your digital footprint is louder than your voice.

title: Message from Void Walker
content: I’ve been where your thoughts disappear.

title: Message from Cyber Monk
content: Detach from the noise. Clarity is coming.

title: Message from Lunar Hacker
content: Even the moon couldn’t hide what you typed.

title: Message from Glitch King
content: Error 404: Your doubts are invalid.

title: Message from Storm Whisper
content: The calm you feel now is just temporary.

title: Message from Velvet Shadow
content: Soft words can still cut deep.

title: Message from Neon Samurai
content: Honor isn’t dead. It’s just offline.

title: Message from Dark Algorithm
content: I calculated your next move… interesting choice.

title: Message from Phantom Signal
content: You’re receiving this for a reason.

title: Message from Solar Drifter
content: Not all who wander are lost… some are watching.

title: Message from Obsidian Mind
content: Your thoughts echo louder in silence.
